input.free_text_description: This system is a file management platform that serves Candidate, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including file. The platform provides capabilities for file. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Candidate, I want to create and manage file records, so that I can track and organize file data effectively.
As a Candidate, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with test exception functionality, so that I can accomplish my test exception-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with quick upload functionality, so that I can accomplish my quick upload-related tasks.
As a Candidate, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
